feed.title: The track and turf field — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Does the town pay for engineering of the track and turf field, and what would rebuilding them cost?

entry.title: The track and turf field: Select Board, 2026-10-20
entry.summary: Place Article 5, middle high school track and field engineering, on the warrant — passed unanimously

entry.title: The track and turf field: Finance Committee, 2026-10-08
entry.summary: Track and field engineering article and capital process debate

entry.title: The track and turf field: School Committee, 2026-10-07
entry.summary: Superintendent to ask Mr. Stevens for a timeline/one-pager on track and field work for the next meeting.

entry.title: The track and turf field: Select Board, 2026-10-06
entry.summary: Veterans exemption articles, PEG access fund amendment, track and field engineering, stormwater advisory article, trust funds article and SAP amendment held off the warrant for now.

entry.title: The track and turf field: Finance Committee, 2026-09-24
entry.summary: Track/turf field engineering, Lunenburg Middle High School. The school committee submitted an article to fund engineering and bid-ready documents for reconstruction of the track and turf field; the overall project is expected to cost roughly $2 million, derived from a prior assessment.

entry.title: Now following: The track and turf field
entry.summary: Does the town pay for engineering of the track and turf field, and what would rebuilding them cost?

entry.title: The track and turf field: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Request the town raise/appropriate/borrow funds for a full feasibility and schematic study of the turf field, track, drainage and retaining wall, as a placeholder warrant article — passed 5-0 (all yes on roll call)

entry.title: The track and turf field: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: Senator Cronin infrastructure earmark. Legislative earmark for school infrastructure with no finalized spending plan; possible uses discussed include ADA accessibility, auditorium lighting/sound, and curtain flame-retardant compliance; a member pushed for track and field design funding.

entry.title: The track and turf field: Capital Planning Committee, 2026-04-30
entry.summary: Committee expects it will be pulled into further discussion of the track and field engineering/planning issue ahead of a special town meeting.

entry.title: The track and turf field: Finance Committee, 2026-02-19
entry.summary: Turf fields debt. A member asked about the amount borrowed for turf fields, part of maturing debt.

entry.title: The track and turf field: School Committee, 2026-01-21
entry.summary: The draft turf field and Kids Kingdom warrant articles were treated as discussion only tonight, with the language considered ready for the town to act on; no formal committee vote was taken on the article text.
